scope: Real local Chromium and temporary isolated SQLite database; no mocked successful responses. Not a physical-device, public-hosting or Russian-connectivity check.
checks: Course module toggles through UI and persists after reload
Assignment UI submit, revision, withdrawal and persisted text
Personal task UI create, complete, edit, reload and delete
Note UI create, live search, safe text, edit and persisted content
Flashcard UI create, hidden answer, reveal and scheduled review
Quiz UI genuine answers, server score, explanations and saved history
Portfolio UI create and genuine own HTML export
Focus timer UI start, pause, stable pause, reset and persisted manual log
